headers.comment: Content-hashed build output. Safe by construction: the hash is in the filename, so a given URL's bytes can never change, and a stale hit is impossible. Everything here shipped max-age=0, must-revalidate, which meant a conditional request for the 8.5MB bundle on every single launch and — more importantly — no usable copy offline, so the service worker's cached shell loaded a dead script tag and the PWA could not boot without a network at all.
NOT immutable: index.html, version.json, manifest.json and sw.js are how the app discovers a new build. Caching them is how a PWA pins itself to an old release with no way out.
